mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS enrollment_id, e.school_id FROM enrollment e JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = e.student_id AND sg.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND sg.is_active = TRUE JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = g.user_id AND gu.school_id = e.school_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND e.school_id = #{schoolId} AND e.status = 'ENROLLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session ls WHERE ls.offering_id = e.offering_id AND ls.status = 'COMPLETED' AND TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) >= e.enrolled_at ) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_evaluation ( school_id, offering_id, enrollment_id, student_id, guardian_id, rating, comment ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{offeringId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{studentId}, #{guardianId}, #{rating}, #{comment} )
mapper.sql: ce.id, ce.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, ce.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, o.term_id AS termId, COALESCE(at.term_name, o.term) AS termName, c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.category, t.id AS teacherId, t.full_name AS teacherName, ce.student_id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS studentName, ce.guardian_id AS guardianId, g.full_name AS guardianName, ce.rating, ce.comment, ce.submitted_at AS submittedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course_evaluation ce JOIN school s ON s.id = ce.school_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = ce.offering_id LEFT JOIN academic_term at ON at.id = o.term_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id JOIN student st ON st.id = ce.student_id JOIN guardian g ON g.id = ce.guardian_id WHERE ce.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND ce.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ce.id, ce.student_id AS studentId, ce.offering_id AS offeringId, ce.rating, ce.submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM course_evaluation ce JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = ce.student_id AND sg.guardian_id = ce.guardian_id AND sg.is_active = TRUE WHERE ce.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND ce.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY ce.submitted_at DESC, ce.id DESC
